name: solidworks-mcp
description: MCP server for SolidWorks automation through the Windows COM API, built with FastMCP.
long_description: Controls SolidWorks via COM for parts, assemblies, sketches, features, drawings, appearances, validation, and selected mechanical mates. Designed for trusted local desktop automation.

tools.name: connect_solidworks
tools.description: Connect to a running SolidWorks instance, launching it if needed.

tools.name: get_solidworks_info
tools.description: Get SolidWorks version and visibility state.

tools.name: create_new_part
tools.description: Create a new part document.

tools.name: create_new_assembly
tools.description: Create a new assembly document.

tools.name: create_new_drawing
tools.description: Create a new drawing document.

tools.name: insert_drawing_view
tools.description: Insert a standard model view into the active drawing.

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: Open an existing .sldprt, .sldasm, or .slddrw file.

tools.name: close_document
tools.description: Close the active document.

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Save the active document.

tools.name: get_document_info
tools.description: Get title, path, and type of the active document.

tools.name: list_open_documents
tools.description: List all open documents.

tools.name: export_document
tools.description: Export to STEP, STL, IGES, PDF, DXF, or Parasolid.

tools.name: insert_component
tools.description: Insert a part/sub-assembly into the active assembly.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List components in the active assembly.

tools.name: get_component_transform
tools.description: Read a component's exact assembly translation and rotation matrix.

tools.name: set_component_transform
tools.description: Set a component's absolute assembly position and Euler rotation.

tools.name: capture_standard_views
tools.description: Export front, back, top, bottom, and isometric PNG views of the active model.

tools.name: fix_component
tools.description: Fix a component in place.

tools.name: float_component
tools.description: Float a fixed component.

tools.name: delete_component
tools.description: Remove a component from the assembly.

tools.name: suppress_component
tools.description: Suppress a component (hide and exclude from calculations).

tools.name: unsuppress_component
tools.description: Unsuppress a previously suppressed component.

tools.name: add_mate
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: mate two faces/planes in the assembly.

tools.name: list_mates
tools.description: List all mates (constraints) in the assembly.

tools.name: list_motion_studies
tools.description: List native SolidWorks Motion Studies in the active document.

tools.name: create_motion_study
tools.description: Create and activate a native SolidWorks Animation study.

tools.name: create_sketch
tools.description: Create a sketch on a standard plane (front/top/right).

tools.name: create_sketch_on_face
tools.description: Create a sketch on an existing body face.

tools.name: close_sketch
tools.description: Exit the active sketch.

tools.name: get_sketch_status
tools.description: Check if a sketch is active.

tools.name: draw_line
tools.description: Draw a line in the active sketch.

tools.name: draw_centerline
tools.description: Draw a centerline (construction geometry) in a part/assembly sketch; required as the revolve axis for revolve_sketch.

tools.name: draw_circle
tools.description: Draw a circle in the active sketch.

tools.name: draw_rectangle
tools.description: Draw a rectangle in the active sketch.

tools.name: draw_arc
tools.description: Draw an arc in the active sketch.

tools.name: draw_spline
tools.description: Draw a 2D B-spline through control points in the active sketch.

tools.name: draw_polygon
tools.description: Draw a regular polygon in the active sketch.

tools.name: add_sketch_dimension
tools.description: Add a driving dimension to sketch entities.

tools.name: add_sketch_relation
tools.description: Add a geometric relation (constraint) between sketch entities.

tools.name: extrude_sketch
tools.description: Boss-extrude the last sketch.

tools.name: cut_extrude
tools.description: Cut-extrude the last sketch.

tools.name: revolve_sketch
tools.description: Revolve the last sketch around its centerline axis.

tools.name: sweep_sketch
tools.description: Sweep a profile sketch along a path sketch.

tools.name: loft_sketches
tools.description: Loft between two or more profile sketches.

tools.name: fillet_edges
tools.description: Fillet every edge of the solid body.

tools.name: chamfer_edges
tools.description: Chamfer every edge of the solid body.

tools.name: shell_body
tools.description: Hollow out the solid body leaving thin walls.

tools.name: linear_pattern
tools.description: Repeat a feature in a linear pattern.

tools.name: circular_pattern
tools.description: Repeat a feature in a circular pattern.

tools.name: hole_wizard
tools.description: Create a hole using the Hole Wizard (simple, counterbore, countersink, tapped).

tools.name: create_weldment_profile
tools.description: Create a structural member (I-beam, tube, channel, angle) along sketch segments using weldment profiles.

tools.name: trim_extend_structural
tools.description: Trim or extend a structural member at an intersection with another body.

tools.name: add_gusset
tools.description: Add a gusset plate (reinforcement triangle) between two faces at a structural joint.

tools.name: add_end_cap
tools.description: Add an end cap plate to close the open end of a structural tube or channel.

tools.name: create_3d_sketch
tools.description: Open a 3D sketch for drawing lines and paths in free 3D space (for structural frames).

tools.name: draw_line_3d
tools.description: Draw a line in 3D space (x,y,z to x,y,z) inside a 3D sketch.

tools.name: create_base_flange
tools.description: Create a sheet metal base flange from the last sketch (first step for sheet metal parts).

tools.name: add_sheet_metal_bend
tools.description: Convert a thin/shelled part to sheet metal, adding bends at sharp edges (Insert Bends).

tools.name: add_sheet_metal_edge_flange
tools.description: Add an edge flange (lip/tab) extending from a sheet metal edge.

tools.name: flatten_sheet_metal
tools.description: Toggle flat pattern view (unfold the sheet metal for CNC/laser cutting).

tools.name: create_helix
tools.description: Create a helix/spiral curve from a circle sketch (for threads, springs, worms).

tools.name: add_thread_feature
tools.description: Create a real 3D thread on a cylindrical face (metric or inch, internal or external).

tools.name: add_cosmetic_thread
tools.description: Add a cosmetic thread (dashed circles in drawings, no real geometry cut).

tools.name: create_knurl
tools.description: Create a knurled diamond/straight pattern on a cylindrical face (grip texture).

tools.name: add_rib
tools.description: Add a rib (thin reinforcing wall) from the last sketch as centerline.

tools.name: mirror_feature
tools.description: Mirror a feature (hole, cut, boss) across a plane for symmetry.

tools.name: mirror_body
tools.description: Mirror an entire solid body across a plane, optionally merging with the original.

tools.name: move_copy_body
tools.description: Move or copy a solid body by translation and rotation (in-place move or N copies).

tools.name: combine_bodies
tools.description: Boolean combine bodies (add/union, subtract, common/intersection).

tools.name: create_reference_plane
tools.description: Create a reference plane offset or angled from an existing plane.

tools.name: create_reference_axis
tools.description: Create a reference axis from two planes or a cylindrical face.

tools.name: split_body
tools.description: Split a solid body into multiple pieces with a plane or face cutter.

tools.name: insert_section_view
tools.description: Insert a section (cut-through) view into a drawing along a cut line.

tools.name: insert_detail_view
tools.description: Insert a magnified detail view of a circled region in a drawing.

tools.name: insert_broken_view
tools.description: Add a broken view to remove the middle of a long part on a drawing.

tools.name: insert_auxiliary_view
tools.description: Insert an auxiliary view projected perpendicular to a selected edge.

tools.name: add_drawing_dimension
tools.description: Add a dimension between entities in a drawing.

tools.name: add_drawing_annotation
tools.description: Add a free text note to a drawing (notes, standards, specs).

tools.name: add_centerline
tools.description: Add a centerline (dashed axis line) to a drawing.

tools.name: add_weld_symbol
tools.description: Add a welding symbol (fillet, bevel, vee, etc.) to a drawing.

tools.name: add_surface_finish
tools.description: Add a surface finish/roughness symbol (Ra) to a drawing.

tools.name: add_gdt_symbol
tools.description: Add a geometric tolerance (GD&T) feature control frame to a drawing.

tools.name: add_balloon
tools.description: Add a numbered BOM balloon callout to a component in a drawing.

tools.name: insert_bom_table
tools.description: Insert a Bill of Materials table into an assembly drawing.

tools.name: insert_cut_list_table
tools.description: Insert a weldment cut list table (cut lengths of structural members).

tools.name: create_exploded_view
tools.description: Create an exploded (blown-apart) view of the active assembly.

tools.name: delete_mate
tools.description: Delete a named assembly mate and verify its removal from the feature tree.

tools.name: add_advanced_mate
tools.description: Add a validated advanced mate, including distance, angle, width, symmetric, lock, or mechanical gear ratio.

tools.name: add_cam_follower_mate
tools.description: Create a stable cam-follower mate using ray selection and CreateMateData/CreateMate.

tools.name: add_screw_mate
tools.description: Create a stable screw mate from two cylindrical entities using typed mate data.

tools.name: add_rack_pinion_mate
tools.description: Create a rack-and-pinion mate from a linear rack edge and cylindrical pinion entity.

tools.name: interference_check
tools.description: Check the active assembly for overlapping/interfering components.

tools.name: create_assembly_pattern
tools.description: Pattern a component in the assembly (linear or circular).

tools.name: set_material
tools.description: Assign a material to the active part (drives mass and BOM).

tools.name: set_appearance
tools.description: Set the color/appearance of the part or a specific face (RGB).

tools.name: get_appearance_properties
tools.description: Read RGB, reflection, transparency, and emission channels from the active model.

tools.name: set_appearance_properties
tools.description: Set native SolidWorks RGB, reflection, transparency, and emission appearance channels.

tools.name: apply_texture
tools.description: Apply a local image texture to the active model or a selected face.

tools.name: remove_texture
tools.description: Remove a texture from the active model or a selected face.

tools.name: apply_metal_finish
tools.description: Apply a native chrome, steel, cast-iron, or aluminum visual finish to a body or face.

tools.name: list_p2m_appearances
tools.description: List native P2M render appearances linked to the active display state.

tools.name: apply_p2m_appearance
tools.description: Apply a native P2M render appearance to the active model and display state.

tools.name: create_automotive_piston
tools.description: Create a parametric automotive piston with ring grooves, hollow underside, and wrist-pin bore.

tools.name: create_automotive_piston_assembly
tools.description: Create a complete piston, wrist-pin, connecting-rod, bearing, and rod-cap SolidWorks assembly.

tools.name: create_automotive_piston_with_connecting_rod
tools.description: Create a clear single-body conceptual piston with ring grooves and an integrated visible connecting rod.

tools.name: create_pedestal_fan_propeller
tools.description: Create an aerodynamic three-blade pedestal-fan propeller with a shared pitch angle.

tools.name: create_configuration
tools.description: Create a configuration (design variant) in the active document.

tools.name: switch_configuration
tools.description: Switch the active document to a named configuration.

tools.name: rebuild_model
tools.description: Rebuild the active model and refresh the SolidWorks feature tree.

tools.name: validate_model
tools.description: Rebuild the active model and report SolidWorks feature errors and warnings.

tools.name: get_document_dependencies
tools.description: List referenced model files and identify broken dependencies.

tools.name: get_persistent_reference
tools.description: Create a base64 persistent ID for a face, edge, or vertex.

tools.name: resolve_persistent_reference
tools.description: Resolve and optionally select a persistent SolidWorks entity reference.

tools.name: list_configurations
tools.description: List configurations and identify the active design variant.

tools.name: delete_configuration
tools.description: Delete a non-active configuration after validation.

tools.name: list_equations
tools.description: List global variables and equations in the active model.

tools.name: add_equation
tools.description: Add and evaluate a SolidWorks equation or global variable.

tools.name: set_equation
tools.description: Update an equation and verify its evaluated value.

tools.name: delete_equation
tools.description: Delete an equation and verify the equation count changed.

tools.name: export_flat_pattern_dxf
tools.description: Export an active sheet-metal part flat pattern to DXF or DWG.

tools.name: pack_and_go
tools.description: Create a portable native Pack and Go copy or validated dependency fallback.

tools.name: list_display_states
tools.description: List display states for a configuration.

tools.name: create_display_state
tools.description: Create and optionally apply a configuration display state.

tools.name: apply_display_state
tools.description: Apply an existing display state.

tools.name: rename_display_state
tools.description: Rename an existing display state.

tools.name: delete_display_state
tools.description: Delete an existing display state.

tools.name: list_features
tools.description: List the feature tree of the active document.

tools.name: get_custom_properties
tools.description: Read custom properties from the active document.

tools.name: set_custom_property
tools.description: Set a custom property on the active document.

tools.name: measure_body
tools.description: Measure mass, volume, surface area, and bounding box.

tools.name: capture_viewport
tools.description: Return the current viewport as an image, without moving the camera.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Read the current selection: entity types, pick points, and owning components.

tools.name: list_faces
tools.description: Inventory the active part's faces with a pick point, area, normal, and surface type.

tools.name: set_units
tools.description: Set the default unit (mm, cm, m, in, ft).

tools.name: set_view
tools.description: Set the camera view orientation (front, isometric, etc.).

tools.name: zoom_to_fit
tools.description: Zoom to fit the entire model in the viewport.

tools.name: zoom_to_area
tools.description: Zoom into a rectangular area of the model.

tools.name: get_view_state
tools.description: Read the current camera zoom, orientation, and display mode as structured data instead of an image.

tools.name: list_macro_methods
tools.description: List the entry points inside a SolidWorks macro file without executing it.

tools.name: run_macro
tools.description: Run a procedure from an existing SolidWorks VBA macro (.swp/.swb/.dll); executes untrusted VBA, so only use trusted files.

tools.name: execute_python
tools.description: Run privileged local Python with sw/doc in scope; disabled unless SOLIDWORKS_MCP_ENABLE_EXECUTE_PYTHON=1.
